other_failure_modes.name: Invalid test set autoregressive features
other_failure_modes.description: The agent creates lag and rolling features based on the target variable, but since the test set does not contain the target, these features evaluate to NaN and are blindly filled with the training set median. This destroys the temporal signal for test predictions and forces the model to rely on static imputed values for its most important features.

other_failure_modes.name: Validation leakage via teacher forcing
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses the true target values from the validation set to construct lag features for its validation predictions, effectively performing 1-step ahead forecasting (teacher forcing). Because multi-step forecasting is required for the test set, the validation score will be highly optimistic and fail to represent true generalization performance.

summary: The agent implements a solid chronological validation split and creates extensive temporal/meteorological features, but critically fails in its handling of autoregressive (lag) features. By using true target values for validation lags (teacher forcing) while filling test lags with static training medians, the validation score is completely disconnected from the actual test performance. Additionally, the agent uses naive ensembling and single evaluations of stochastic models.
